what: The TXM collection's own detector, scored three ways, plus the overlap ceiling its reference labels impose.

cross_validated.convention: 5-fold grouped by IMAGE; 250,000 sampled rows per fold drawn from hand-painted pixels, not whole frames; owner corrections only
cross_validated.model_version: v4 members (member_split_v4.json); the deployed joblibs are v5 and no v5 grouped-CV artefact exists in either repository
cross_validated.not_specimen_independent: grouping is by image, not by specimen, so a whole specimen is never held out
cross_validated.not_restricted: this block is the cross-validation artefact as it was run, over all 71 labelled frames of four specimen groups. It predates the restriction to b2 and b3 and cannot be recomputed over the restricted set: no per-fold record survives. The two blocks below ARE restricted.

labelled_domain.convention: intersection over union restricted to the labelled domain (painted crack OR painted not-crack)

whole_frame.convention: full-resolution IoU against the operator's painted crack, whole frame

window_stages.note: one 1100 px window of the example frame; these are not corpus figures
window_stages._agreement_source: read from paper/figures/txm_stats.json, which paper/figures/txm_full.py writes from the cached arrays

scale.provenance: DERIVED from operator-supplied mosaic geometry, not read from instrument metadata; marked [TODO-AUTHOR] in the TXM repository
